# Path -> risk tier. First matching line wins; a PR takes the highest tier of any file it touches.
# Patterns are bash globs; * also matches "/". Anything unmatched is T2 (round up).
# T3: platform manifests, entitlements, signing, build settings, pipeline and gate files.
T3 *.csproj
T3 *.props
T3 *.targets
T3 Directory.*
T3 global.json
T3 *.entitlements
T3 *Info.plist
T3 *AndroidManifest.xml
T3 .github/*
T3 scripts/*
T3 fastlane/*
T3 *.keystore
T3 *.jks
T3 *.p12
T3 *.p8
T3 *.mobileprovision
# T0: docs and comments only.
T0 docs/*
T0 *.md
# T1: UI, styles, copy.
T1 *.xaml
T1 src/Sprout.App/Resources/*
